name: Campingplatz Bergheimat
beschreibung: The campsite Bergheimat is located on the outskirts of Bad Hindelang in Oberallgäu. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as rental accommodations. Guests can reach the town centre with shopping facilities and dining options in just a few minutes. The pitch is terraced and offers a view of the surrounding mountains. Sanitary facilities, a playground and a small grocery store are available.
